function.name: write_file
function.arguments:
{"path": "/tmp/create_accounts_table.py", "content": "# Databricks notebook source
# MAGIC %md
# MAGIC ## Create accounts9ad208 feature table

# COMMAND ----------

# Read all three batch files from workspace
batch1_path = "/Workspace/tmp/mlpab8061c6/batch_1.csv"
batch2_path = "/Workspace/tmp/mlpab8061c6/batch_2.csv"
batch3_path = "/Workspace/tmp/mlpab8061c6/batch_3.csv"

# COMMAND ----------

# Read batch 1
df1 = spark.read.csv(batch1_path, header=True, inferSchema=True)
print(f"Batch 1: {df1.count()} rows")

# COMMAND ----------

# Read batch 2
df2 = spark.read.csv(batch2_path, header=True, inferSchema=True)
print(f"Batch 2: {df2.count()} rows")

# COMMAND ----------

# Read batch 3
df3 = spark.read.csv(batch3_path, header=True, inferSchema=True)
print(f"Batch 3: {df3.count()} rows")

# COMMAND ----------

# Union all batches
all_df = df1.unionByName(df2).unionByName(df3)
print(f"Total rows before deduplication: {all_df.count()}")

# COMMAND ----------

# Show schema
all_df.printSchema()

# COMMAND ----------

# Deduplicate: keep only the latest row per row_id (based on updated_at)
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
from pyspark.sql.functions import row_number, col

window_spec = Window.partitionBy("row_id").orderBy(col("updated_at").desc())

# Add row number within each row_id group, ordered by updated_at descending
dedup_df = all_df.withColumn("row_num", row_number().over(window_spec)) \
    .filter(col("row_num") == 1) \
    .drop("row_num")

print(f"Total rows after deduplication: {dedup_df.count()}")

# COMMAND ----------

# Create the table in Unity Catalog
catalog_name = "workspace"
schema_name = "mlpab8061c6"
table_name = "accounts9ad208"

full_table_name = f"{catalog_name}.{schema_name}.{table_name}"

# Write as Delta table
dedup_df.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").saveAsTable(full_table_name)

print(f"Table created: {full_table_name}")

# COMMAND ----------

# Verify the table
df_result = spark.sql(f"SELECT * FROM {full_table_name} ORDER BY row_id LIMIT 10")
df_result.show()

# COMMAND ----------

# Count total rows
total_rows = spark.sql(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {full_table_name}").collect()[0][0]
print(f"Final table row count: {total_rows}")
"}

# Read batch 3
df3 = spark.read.csv(batch3_path, header=True, inferSchema=True)

all_df = df1.unionByName(df2).unionByName(df3)
